goal: Build an original Lum demon character base with real textures, full humanoid rig, facial expressions and bounded secondary motion while keeping the Samsung runtime offline and provenance-safe.
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

referenceStyle.copyrightRule: Professor reference informs an original Lum design only; no franchise character cloning

technicalBaseDonor.name: TalkingHead MPFB Female
technicalBaseDonor.license: CC0 model; TalkingHead integration code is MIT
technicalBaseDonor.role: primary technical donor because it is textured, skinned and designed for ARKit/Oculus facial shape workflows

animeAestheticReference.name: VRoid Base Female
animeAestheticReference.role: anime proportion/material/VRM semantic reference only until a non-pointer immutable binary source is proven
animeAestheticReference.reasonNotPrimary: the Continuum GLB repository path resolves to a 21-byte pointer in clean CI rather than the binary payload

faceRigReference.copyPolicy: reuse permissively licensed concepts/code with attribution; never treat unrelated example avatars as automatically redistributable

falloutCommunityReferences.restriction: do not copy GPL implementation into the Android runtime without an explicit compatible licensing decision
no Bethesda game data or third-party mod meshes/textures are redistributed

runtimePhysics.hair: dedicated hair bone chains using Godot SpringBoneSimulator3D first; MIT WiggleBone is comparison/fallback
runtimePhysics.chestSecondaryMotion: Breast_L and Breast_R helper bones with bounded spring motion only; no whole-torso soft body
runtimePhysics.tail: six-plus bone spring chain with angle/collision constraints
runtimePhysics.wings: skeletal spring frame; optional SoftBody3D membrane experiment behind mobile quality gate
runtimePhysics.cloth: SoftBody3D only for isolated cloth/membrane meshes and only after Samsung performance proof

targetRig.humanoid: SkeletonProfileHumanoid-compatible full body including fingers and eye control
targetRig.face: ARKit-style face units plus Oculus 15 visemes, blink/eyes/jaw/mouth required

textureMutation.skin: author original warm crimson skin material/texture from Professor reference palette
textureMutation.eyes: author original dark dramatic eye palette
textureMutation.markings: author original tattoo/marking overlay; do not trace third-party symbols
